notes.title: Stitched Re-release HD version
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

For this Halloween season, we are re-releasing Stitched with major updates! Below are the changes that we made to the game. Hope everyone enjoy the new update!

- Changed the game to support 16:9 aspect ratio with full HD support
- Added several new locations
- Updated existing story line
- Added 2 new endings
- Added a detailed map to each area of the factory
- Replaced various new environment tile sets with improved artworks
- Update existing artworks and added several new artworks
- Added full mouse support
- Updated save/load menu with improved GUI
- Updated in-game menu with improved GUI
- Updated option menu with improved GUI
- Added counter for thread obtained through in-game menu
- Added keyboard config support
- Full controller support
- Added animation for certain items
- Adjusted several maps to enhance the areas
- Updated various existing dialogues and added new dialogues
- Added new icons/update existing icons for hotkey and stability bar
- Updated a few existing puzzles to add more accessibility
- Added 2 new achievements
- Added 5 additional save slots
- Fixed various existing bugs

Below are several screenshots of the new changes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40602871/7415c5a2450d0a8d458820bcd5aba64e7a8c7207.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40602871/66583f3638d00e82ff13565f6254ac7691b6e58f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40602871/24f454cf2a9eecc54cb7554af481e2cbabf8c03b.png[/img]

Also, stay tunes for more news on Mother's Nightmare.

Cheers!
- Fluffex Studios
